discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and its physiological role, enabling GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology underpins transformative diabetes and obesity drugs; the trio has already received the Lasker (2024), Breakthrough Prize and Gairdner awards, the classic sequence that comes before a Nobel, and impact on public health keeps growing.
